resources.string: This database is unavailable. Upgrade to MDBX3 to keep using it. The upgrade preserves the original file.
New databases use MDBX3. MDBX1 files can only be opened for upgrading.
The local MDBX1 copy cannot be read. Reopen the original MDBX1 file to upgrade it. The original database has not been changed.

The upgrade converts the copy saved on this device into a new local MDBX3 database. Remote changes that have not been downloaded are not included. The original remote file and local copy are preserved. Configure synchronization separately for the new database.
